note: Both sets extract essentially the same four relations (Eqs. 7-6 through 7-10) with heavy internal duplication, and both bind the values to the right quantities with the Region 3 / Taylor-expansion / PID conditions kept. Set A adds the correct definition of θ (full-span rotor-collective blade-pitch angle), but it also contains a PID variant whose value drops the derivative dot (K_D N_Gear ΔΩ instead of ΔΩ̇) and two quotes stitched together with a bracketed '[torque]' substitution rather than verbatim text. Set B's formulas are consistently faithful but it omits the θ definition, garbles one PID value (ΔẊ_Ω) and has two truncated quotes ('on 3 is…', 'generator sp'). Net differences are minor and offsetting.
